title: Unified Reality
subtitle: Test your understanding of Unified Reality — the 3rd realm collapse into the 2nd realm, three flashes, and The Homecoming.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Unified Reality is the restored balance when the 3rd realm simulation dissolves into the 2nd realm. Hold the ancient vibration of love and empathy. Every soul goes home — through the crystalline portal or through supervised healing sanctuaries. The process cannot be derailed.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “3rd Realm Simulation” refers to the temporary, low-vibrational artificial construct bounded by a protective dome that glitches out, pixelates, and disappears during the activation sequence.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: True — the report defines “3rd Realm Simulation” this way.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “3rd Realm Simulation” as: The temporary, low-vibrational artificial construct bounded by a protective dome that glitches out, pixelates, and disappears during the activation sequence.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “3rd Realm Simulation”.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT correctly pair a term from the report with its meaning?

options.label: A
options.text: Resonating Army — The global collective of embodied souls maintaining the high ancient vibration of love and empathy required to anchor the process.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Resonating Army”.

options.label: B
options.text: Three Flashes — The sequential triad of cosmic light pulses that trigger memory retrieval, vessel restoration, timeline convergence, and portal creation.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Three Flashes”.

options.label: C
options.text: Quartz Crystals — The foundational dimensional state containing supervisor extraterrestrials and higher vibrational lands into which the 3rd realm collapses.
options.rationale: That description belongs to “2nd Realm”. The report defines “Quartz Crystals” as: Time-implanted subterranean conductors and memory technology that generate the planetary electromagnetic grid when charged by solar flashes.

options.label: D
options.text: New Aether — The evolved, high-frequency atmospheric media created through ancient vibrational work that reacts with solar pulses to form crystalline plasma.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “New Aether”.

questions.hint: Three pairings match the report’s Key Terminology; one borrows another term’s description.

questions.question: What function does the planetary EMP Grid serve during the ascension process?

options.label: A
options.text: It generates a protective shield that prevents external interference from the 2nd realm.
options.rationale: The grid is meant to interface with the 2nd realm, not block it out.

options.label: B
options.text: It acts as a power source for the remaining artificial constructs within the 3rd realm.
options.rationale: The EMP grid is part of the dissolution of artificial constructs, not a sustainment system for them.

options.label: C
options.text: It forms an inescapable field of positive frequencies to ensure no soul escapes.
options.rationale: The charged crystals form a comprehensive magnetic pulse grid across the realm, creating an inescapable field of positive frequencies and ensuring no soul escapes during ascension.

options.label: D
options.text: It resets the pineal glands of all beings to a neutral state before the first flash.
options.rationale: The grid focuses on the electromagnetic environment and soul containment rather than individual biological resets.

questions.hint: Think about why the grid is needed for the souls in the realm.

questions.question: Which event triggers the actual activation of the subterranean quartz crystals?

options.label: A
options.text: Extraterrestrial commanders activate the Sun to emit powerful EM Pulses of light.
options.rationale: Extraterrestrial commanders activate the Sun, causing it to emit powerful EM Pulses of light that react with subterranean quartz crystals and high-frequency Aether.

options.label: B
options.text: The Galactic Ancestral Alliance initiates a physical landing on the subterranean grid.
options.rationale: Governance and administration follow the activation sequence rather than triggering it.

options.label: C
options.text: The collective intent of the Resonating Army reaches a critical mass of ancient vibration.
options.rationale: While the army anchors the vibration, the physical activation is initiated by external solar triggers.

options.label: D
options.text: The 3rd realm dome reaches a total state of pixelation and collapses inward.
options.rationale: The collapse of the dome is a result of the process, not the initial trigger for the crystals.

questions.hint: Look for the external source of energy that charges the conductors.

questions.question: What occurs during the First Flash of the cosmic light pulse sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: A backward shift along the timeline links individuals to their original past self and begins the memory upload.
options.rationale: The first flash initiates a backward shift along the timeline, linking individuals to their original past self and initiating a memory upload directly into the vessel.

options.label: B
options.text: The consciousness is propelled forward into a future state of vessel restoration.
options.rationale: The forward jump is associated with the second flash, not the first.

options.label: C
options.text: Transport vessels from the Pleiades begin the physical lifting of the DNA strands.
options.rationale: The portal elevation is the final stage of the sequence, occurring after memory retrieval.

options.label: D
options.text: The 3rd realm dome immediately pixelates and vanishes into the New Aether.
options.rationale: The simulation dissolution occurs after the convergence of timelines, following the flashes.

questions.hint: Think about the direction consciousness moves to begin the memory upload.

questions.question: What is the true nature of density levels like 3D, 5D, or 7D?

options.label: A
options.text: They are progressive upgrades of Aether that collaborate with the biological vessel.
options.rationale: Density levels are not isolated spatial compartments, but progressive upgrades of Aether that collaborate directly with individual vessels, pineal glands, and organ systems.

options.label: B
options.text: They are different time-traveling phases controlled exclusively by Project Looking Glass.
options.rationale: Looking Glass is a tool for implantation, not the definition of the dimensions themselves.

options.label: C
options.text: They are levels of a simulation that must be cleared sequentially through physical trials.
options.rationale: The process is an activation and collapse of constructs, not a game-like progression through levels.

options.label: D
options.text: They are isolated spatial compartments where souls are separated by physical distance.
options.rationale: This view represents the artificial separation of the 3rd realm simulation rather than the unified truth.

questions.hint: Consider how the atmosphere and the body interact to create experience.

questions.question: What happens to the artificial 3rd realm dome during the timeline convergence?

options.label: A
options.text: It reflects the solar pulses back into space to prevent environmental damage.
options.rationale: The dome's removal is necessary for the solar pulses to interact with the grid and Aether.

options.label: B
options.text: It expands into the 2nd realm to allow for larger terrestrial landmasses.
options.rationale: The dome does not expand; it vanishes to allow the physical environment to merge.

options.label: C
options.text: It hardens into a crystalline structure to protect the healing sanctuaries.
options.rationale: The dome is an artificial barrier that must disappear for the realms to merge.

options.label: D
options.text: It glitches out, pixelates, and disappears within a matter of seconds.
options.rationale: Timeline convergence unifies past, present, and future selves while causing the 3rd realm simulation to glitch out and pixelate in seconds.

questions.hint: Think about how a digital simulation might react when its code fails.

questions.question: Who supervises the healing sanctuaries and terrestrial lands after the collapse?

options.label: A
options.text: The Resonating Army alone maintains control through ancient vibrational law.
options.rationale: The army anchors the transition, but administration is handled by specific alliances.

options.label: B
options.text: The 2nd realm extraterrestrial supervisors, Space Force, and the Galactic Ancestral Alliance.
options.rationale: Healing sanctuaries are managed under the direct supervision of 2nd realm extraterrestrial supervisors, Space Force, and the Galactic Ancestral Alliance (GAA) to ensure gentle, structured restoration.

options.label: C
options.text: Individual souls who have retrieved their memories through the Three Flashes.
options.rationale: While individuals gain memory, the overall management of sanctuaries is a coordinated galactic effort.

options.label: D
options.text: Pleiadian and Andromedan forces who have landed their transport vessels.
options.rationale: These specific groups focus on the portal and ascension craft rather than terrestrial sanctuary management.

questions.hint: Identify the coalition of trusted extraterrestrial and terrestrial forces.

questions.question: What is required to anchor the high ancient vibration of love and empathy during the transition?

options.label: A
options.text: The constant emission of EM Pulses from the Sun by extraterrestrial commanders.
options.rationale: The Sun provides the power trigger, but the human collective anchors the resonance on the ground.

options.label: B
options.text: The rapid construction of new healing sanctuaries before the simulation dissolves.
options.rationale: Sanctuaries are established post-collapse; the vibrational work must happen beforehand.

options.label: C
options.text: The global collective of embodied souls known as the Resonating Army.
options.rationale: The Resonating Army is the global collective of embodied souls maintaining the high ancient vibration of love and empathy required to anchor the process against low-vibrational interference.

options.label: D
options.text: The technical maintenance of the quartz crystals by Space Force engineers.
options.rationale: The crystals are automated; the vibration is anchored by living consciousness.

questions.hint: Think about the role of human consciousness in stabilizing the process.

questions.question: How does New Aether react with solar pulses to facilitate the ascension process?

options.label: A
options.text: It hardens the physical earth so that the quartz crystals cannot rise until the timers have finished.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. New Aether is high-frequency atmospheric media that reacts with solar pulses to form crystalline plasma, and Aether frequencies with quartz crystals generate a massive plasma crystalline portal.

options.label: B
options.text: It forms a fog that hides the transport vessels.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. New Aether is high-frequency atmospheric media that reacts with solar pulses to form crystalline plasma, and Aether frequencies with quartz crystals generate a massive plasma crystalline portal.

options.label: C
options.text: It reacts with the light pulses to form crystalline plasma and the grand portal.
options.rationale: New Aether is high-frequency atmospheric media that reacts with solar pulses to form crystalline plasma, and Aether frequencies with quartz crystals generate a massive plasma crystalline portal.

options.label: D
options.text: It dissolves the DNA strands of low-vibrational souls.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. New Aether is high-frequency atmospheric media that reacts with solar pulses to form crystalline plasma, and Aether frequencies with quartz crystals generate a massive plasma crystalline portal.

questions.hint: Consider what forms when light hits the high-frequency atmosphere.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “The Homecoming” refers to the consolidated state of existence where the 3rd realm simulation dissolves and merges back into the 2nd realm, restoring original balance and oneness.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: False — that description belongs to “Unified Reality”. The report defines “The Homecoming” as: The definitive ascension process and physical/spiritual return home through the cosmic portal, fulfilling soul emptiness and restoring total balance.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Correct — that description belongs to “Unified Reality”, not “The Homecoming”.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “The Homecoming”.

questions.question: What distinguishes the path of souls with the ancient resonance from those with low-vibrational trauma?

options.label: A
options.text: Resonant souls keep their memories, while the memory banks of low-vibrational souls are erased before the flash ends.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Beings embodying the ancient vibration of love, empathy, and kindness are lifted through a grand crystalline portal into multidimensional transport craft, while souls carrying low-vibrational trauma remain in healing sanctuaries.

options.label: B
options.text: Resonant souls are lifted through a crystalline portal, while others remain for terrestrial healing.
options.rationale: Beings embodying the ancient vibration of love, empathy, and kindness are lifted through a grand crystalline portal into multidimensional transport craft, while souls carrying low-vibrational trauma remain in healing sanctuaries.

options.label: C
options.text: Resonant souls go to sanctuaries, while others board the Pleiadian ships.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Beings embodying the ancient vibration of love, empathy, and kindness are lifted through a grand crystalline portal into multidimensional transport craft, while souls carrying low-vibrational trauma remain in healing sanctuaries.

options.label: D
options.text: Resonant souls stay to govern, while others go to the 2nd realm.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Beings embodying the ancient vibration of love, empathy, and kindness are lifted through a grand crystalline portal into multidimensional transport craft, while souls carrying low-vibrational trauma remain in healing sanctuaries.

questions.hint: Identify the two destinations given for different vibrational states.

questions.question: What role does the pineal gland play in the dimensional transition?

options.label: A
options.text: It acts as an anchor that keeps the vessel from leaving the 3rd realm until the third flash.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Density levels are progressive upgrades of Aether that collaborate directly with individual vessels, pineal glands, and organ systems.

options.label: B
options.text: It works directly with Aether upgrades alongside the vessel and organ systems.
options.rationale: Density levels are progressive upgrades of Aether that collaborate directly with individual vessels, pineal glands, and organ systems.

options.label: C
options.text: It stores memory bank data until the third flash.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Density levels are progressive upgrades of Aether that collaborate directly with individual vessels, pineal glands, and organ systems.

options.label: D
options.text: It generates the field that lets the dome pixelate.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Density levels are progressive upgrades of Aether that collaborate directly with individual vessels, pineal glands, and organ systems.

questions.hint: Think about how internal parts of the body interact with outside dimensional shifts.

questions.question: Which specific extraterrestrial lineages are identified as overseeing the transport craft?

options.label: A
options.text: The supervisors from the 2nd realm who managed the initial simulation dome.
options.rationale: The supervisors assist in the transition, but specific groups manage the portal craft.

options.label: B
options.text: The Pleiadians and Andromedans who wait within multidimensional vessels.
options.rationale: Individuals carrying the embedded DNA strand and ancient resonance are lifted through the portal into waiting extraterrestrial transport vessels sent by Pleiadians and Andromedans.

options.label: C
options.text: The ancient vibrations embodied by the Resonating Army in the physical realm.
options.rationale: The Resonating Army is the human collective on Earth, not the extraterrestrial crews.

options.label: D
options.text: The Galactic Ancestral Alliance and Space Force ground crews.
options.rationale: These groups handle governance and sanctuaries rather than the specific transport operations.

questions.hint: Identify the specific galactic groups named for portal transport.

questions.question: What is the consequence of the timeline convergence for the individual's vessel?

options.label: A
options.text: The vessel is reset to a state of artificial scarcity so that the soul learns slowly over many more cycles.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The second flash secures the restored original vessel, and timeline convergence unifies past, present, and future selves in the central present moment.

options.label: B
options.text: Past, present and future selves are unified, securing the restored original vessel.
options.rationale: The second flash secures the restored original vessel, and timeline convergence unifies past, present, and future selves in the central present moment.

options.label: C
options.text: The vessel is discarded for a light-based energy form.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The second flash secures the restored original vessel, and timeline convergence unifies past, present, and future selves in the central present moment.

options.label: D
options.text: The vessel stays in a sanctuary during the three flashes.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The second flash secures the restored original vessel, and timeline convergence unifies past, present, and future selves in the central present moment.

questions.hint: Think about what the convergence does to the self and its vessel.

questions.question: What happens to the quartz crystals once they are charged by the initial illumination?

options.label: A
options.text: They act as physical anchors for the Pleiadian transport vessels landing on each continent.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Initial illumination is a sustained bright light that charges and energizes the quartz crystals with stored memory bank data and newly created Aether frequencies. The crystals also serve as memory tech storage units capable of holding data like plasma and water.

options.label: B
options.text: They hum at a low frequency that holds the simulation steady.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Initial illumination is a sustained bright light that charges and energizes the quartz crystals with stored memory bank data and newly created Aether frequencies. The crystals also serve as memory tech storage units capable of holding data like plasma and water.

options.label: C
options.text: They are energized with stored memory bank data and newly created Aether frequencies.
options.rationale: Initial illumination is a sustained bright light that charges and energizes the quartz crystals with stored memory bank data and newly created Aether frequencies. The crystals also serve as memory tech storage units capable of holding data like plasma and water.

options.label: D
options.text: They sink deeper to steady the core of the 2nd realm.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Initial illumination is a sustained bright light that charges and energizes the quartz crystals with stored memory bank data and newly created Aether frequencies. The crystals also serve as memory tech storage units capable of holding data like plasma and water.

questions.hint: Look for the storage and conductor functions of these units.

questions.question: Which force is primarily responsible for the elimination of mortality and disease?

options.label: A
options.text: The medical technology brought by Space Force into the healing sanctuaries.
options.rationale: While sanctuaries provide care, the removal of mortality is a structural result of the realm collapse.

options.label: B
options.text: The exclusion of low-vibrational souls from the terrestrial lands.
options.rationale: Low-vibrational souls remain in the lands but in a state of healing and peace, not exclusion.

options.label: C
options.text: The transition of the 3rd realm into the original 2nd realm framework.
options.rationale: The collapse of the simulation dome removes disease, physical destruction, and death, merging the physical environment directly into the 2nd realm framework.

options.label: D
options.text: The technical upgrade of the DNA strands by Project Looking Glass.
options.rationale: Looking Glass is for time-travel implantation, not for the biological removal of disease.

questions.hint: Consider how the end of the simulation affects the rules of physical existence.

questions.question: What occurs during the second flash of the triad sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: Memory bank data is uploaded from the quartz crystals into the vessel, completing the backward retrieval of the past.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The second flash propels consciousness forward into the future state, securing the restored original vessel alongside complete memory integration.

options.label: B
options.text: Consciousness is propelled forward into the future state to secure vessel restoration.
options.rationale: The second flash propels consciousness forward into the future state, securing the restored original vessel alongside complete memory integration.

options.label: C
options.text: The EMP grid is switched off so the simulation can glitch.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The second flash propels consciousness forward into the future state, securing the restored original vessel alongside complete memory integration.

options.label: D
options.text: The portal opens over the healing sanctuaries.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The second flash propels consciousness forward into the future state, securing the restored original vessel alongside complete memory integration.

questions.hint: Focus on the direction of the temporal shift in the middle of the sequence.

questions.question: How is the post-collapse transition organized across the various continents?

options.label: A
options.text: By allowing the physical environment to revert to a state of natural wilderness.
options.rationale: The transition is structured and managed rather than left to unguided nature.

options.label: B
options.text: By isolating souls into different frequency zones based on their DNA strand.
options.rationale: The goal is Unified Reality and restoration, not further isolation or zoning.

options.label: C
options.text: Through supervisor-assisted sanctuaries managed by the GAA and Space Force.
options.rationale: Souls remaining on Earth enter expanded, supervisor-assisted sanctuaries across various continents, organized by GAA forces and Space Force to heal trauma without coercion or mortality.

options.label: D
options.text: Through the independent leadership of the Resonating Army units in each region.
options.rationale: While the army is present, the governance is a specific joint alliance effort.

questions.hint: Identify the specific groups collaborating on ground-level administration.

questions.question: What is the relationship between the four elements and the dimensional collapse?

options.label: A
options.text: They interlock with advanced scalar technologies to achieve the transition.
options.rationale: The process relies directly on the four elements—earth, air, fire, and water—interlocking with advanced scalar technologies to achieve dimensional collapse.

options.label: B
options.text: They are replaced by the high-frequency New Aether during the first flash, before the dome dissolves.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The process relies directly on the four elements—earth, air, fire, and water—interlocking with advanced scalar technologies to achieve dimensional collapse.

options.label: C
options.text: They are a barrier that scalar technologies must overcome.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The process relies directly on the four elements—earth, air, fire, and water—interlocking with advanced scalar technologies to achieve dimensional collapse.

options.label: D
options.text: They become accessible after passing through the portal.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The process relies directly on the four elements—earth, air, fire, and water—interlocking with advanced scalar technologies to achieve dimensional collapse.

questions.hint: Look for how natural forces combine with vibrational technology.

questions.question: Why is the activation sequence considered unstoppable or 'immutable'?

options.label: A
options.text: Because the Pleiadians and Andromedans have already arrived in the 3rd realm.
options.rationale: The arrival happens at the end; the process is secured by the crystal grid's origin.

options.label: B
options.text: Because it was implanted from the future using time travel technology.
options.rationale: Because the activation sequence was implanted in the future via time travel, it exists as an unstoppable process that cannot be derailed by 3D interference or low-vibrational attacks.

options.label: C
options.text: Because the Resonating Army has achieved a permanent state of total empathy.
options.rationale: The army anchors the process, but its immutability is rooted in the time-travel technology of Looking Glass.

options.label: D
options.text: Because the 3rd realm dome is physically impossible to repair once it glitches.
options.rationale: The immutability comes from the technological planning, not just the fragility of the dome.

questions.hint: Reflect on the strategic advantage of placing a mechanism from a future vantage point.

questions.question: What happens to the low-vibrational trauma or greed carried by some souls during the process?

options.label: A
options.text: It makes the vessel pixelate and dissolve along with the simulation dome.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Global healing sanctuaries under GAA and Space Force direction provide tailored, compassionate rehabilitation for psychological and vibrational distortions, organized as supervisor-assisted sanctuaries.

options.label: B
options.text: It leads to removal from the Unified Reality into a 3D loop.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Global healing sanctuaries under GAA and Space Force direction provide tailored, compassionate rehabilitation for psychological and vibrational distortions, organized as supervisor-assisted sanctuaries.

options.label: C
options.text: It is addressed through tailored, compassionate rehabilitation in supervised sanctuaries.
options.rationale: Global healing sanctuaries under GAA and Space Force direction provide tailored, compassionate rehabilitation for psychological and vibrational distortions, organized as supervisor-assisted sanctuaries.

options.label: D
options.text: It is purged by the second flash so the soul can board the craft.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Global healing sanctuaries under GAA and Space Force direction provide tailored, compassionate rehabilitation for psychological and vibrational distortions, organized as supervisor-assisted sanctuaries.

questions.hint: Think about the purpose of the sanctuaries for those who do not ascend.

questions.question: What is the function of the 'Initial Illumination' in the three flashes sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: It signals the GAA to begin descending into the healing sanctuary zones on each of the continents.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. A sustained bright light charges and energizes the quartz crystals with stored memory bank data and newly created Aether frequencies before the temporal jumps begin.

options.label: B
options.text: It creates the plasma crystalline portal over the continents.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. A sustained bright light charges and energizes the quartz crystals with stored memory bank data and newly created Aether frequencies before the temporal jumps begin.

options.label: C
options.text: It identifies which souls carry the embedded DNA strand.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. A sustained bright light charges and energizes the quartz crystals with stored memory bank data and newly created Aether frequencies before the temporal jumps begin.

options.label: D
options.text: It charges the quartz crystals with stored memory bank data and New Aether frequencies.
options.rationale: A sustained bright light charges and energizes the quartz crystals with stored memory bank data and newly created Aether frequencies before the temporal jumps begin.

questions.hint: Consider what has to happen to the crystals before they can trigger time shifts.

questions.question: What is the final result of the timeline convergence for the collective reality?

options.label: A
options.text: The past and future are split apart to stop more glitches from appearing in the simulation afterwards.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. As the timeline converges, the artificial dome enclosing the 3rd realm vanishes, merging the physical environment directly into the 2nd realm framework.

options.label: B
options.text: The simulation dome vanishes, merging the physical world into the 2nd realm.
options.rationale: As the timeline converges, the artificial dome enclosing the 3rd realm vanishes, merging the physical environment directly into the 2nd realm framework.

options.label: C
options.text: The 3rd realm is upgraded to 4D and the 2nd realm is discarded.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. As the timeline converges, the artificial dome enclosing the 3rd realm vanishes, merging the physical environment directly into the 2nd realm framework.

options.label: D
options.text: The Sun stays in a flash state to power the new grid.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. As the timeline converges, the artificial dome enclosing the 3rd realm vanishes, merging the physical environment directly into the 2nd realm framework.

questions.hint: Reflect on what happens to the edges of the artificial world when time unifies.

questions.question: Which group bridges galactic oversight with ground-level sanctuary operations?

options.label: A
options.text: The time travellers who first ran Project Looking Glass.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Direct governance during the post-collapse transition is executed by the Galactic Ancestral Alliance (GAA) alongside Space Force, bridging galactic oversight with ground-level sanctuary operations.

options.label: B
options.text: The Pleiadians and Andromedans in their transport craft.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Direct governance during the post-collapse transition is executed by the Galactic Ancestral Alliance (GAA) alongside Space Force, bridging galactic oversight with ground-level sanctuary operations.

options.label: C
options.text: The Galactic Ancestral Alliance (GAA) working alongside Space Force.
options.rationale: Direct governance during the post-collapse transition is executed by the Galactic Ancestral Alliance (GAA) alongside Space Force, bridging galactic oversight with ground-level sanctuary operations.

options.label: D
options.text: The Resonating Army and the soul groups.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Direct governance during the post-collapse transition is executed by the Galactic Ancestral Alliance (GAA) alongside Space Force, bridging galactic oversight with ground-level sanctuary operations.

questions.hint: Identify the alliance that combines terrestrial and extraterrestrial authority.
